full_judgment:
Mr. Md. Miftah Uddin Choudhury, J: This Rule arises out of the judgment and decree dated 18.02.1998 passed by the Additional District Judge, First Court, Naogaon in Title Appeal No.28 of 1993 preferred against the judgment and decree dated 26.11.1992 passed by the Assistant Judge, First Additional Court, Naogaon in Other Class Suit No.64 of 1992. 

 6. After hearing the parties the learned Assistant Judge by his judgment and decree dated 26.11.1992 dismissed the suit with the finding along with others that the plaintiffs have got no locus standi to field the suit. In deciding the suit in his judgment the trial court made some adverse findings that the defendant Nos. l and 2 in collusion with some corrupt government employees released the suit property from the list of vested property. The trial Court also found that the plaintiffs are no more lessees in the suit property since the lease granted in their favour had not been renewed and for want of any legal character their suit is not maintainable under Section 42 of the Specific Relief Act. The trial court also found that the plaintiffs are possessors of the suit property and the lease granted in their favour may be renewed if otherwise not barred by any law. Against the said judgment and decree of the trial court the plaintiffs did not prefer any appeal, rather being aggrieved with the adverse findings of the trial court the defendant Nos. l and 2 preferred Title Appeal No.28 of 1993 in the Court of District Judge, Naogaon, on transfer the same was heard by the learned Additional District Judge, First Court, Naogaon who by the impugned judgment and decree dated 18.02.1998 allowed the appeal and set aside the adverse findings of the trial court and affirmed the finding of the trial court that the suit is not maintainable. 

 7. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the impugned judgment and decree the plaintiffs though they did not file any appeal before the appellate court filed this revision and obtained the rule.
